points: The $80 short is already $11.50 in the money (P(finish ITM) 91%) — this is no longer about whether it gets tested, but what to do with it.

Waiting 5 trading days cuts recovery odds 9% → 0% and E[P&L] to -910 — the odds erode with the clock.
